Accepted.description: 202 of `POST /v1/reviews` and reruns: durable admission, not a finished review.

reused.description: The answer replays an earlier request with the same key.

ApiRole.description: What an API client or a signed-in person may do, cumulative.

oneOf.description: Also request reviews, reruns and cancellations.

Attempt.description: `GET /v1/runs/:id/attempts`: one model call as the ledger recorded it.

charge_micro_usd.description: `None` while unknown; never shown as zero.

repository_id.description: `None` for actions of no single repository, such as signing in.

AuditPage.description: One page, newest first; pass `next_before` as `before` for the next one.

CancelOutcome.description: `POST /v1/runs/:id/cancel`: the state after the call; a committed run keeps its own.

limitations.description: Why the candidate is rejected or unresolved, when it is.

proposed_severity.description: The proposer's guess; the verifier sets the finding's severity.

ChangeEvent.description: One logged event of a change: generation, skip, SCM failure, repair.

ChangePage.description: One page, newest first; pass `next_before` as `before` for the next one.

CheckRequest.description:
A requested run of one allowed profile with its parameters; `Execution::command` still
decides whether it runs and what its argv is.

CodeRef.description: Exact span inside a pinned blob; resolved by the harness, never by a model.

CostSummary.description: Cost with explicit unknown part; an unknown charge is never recorded as zero.

known.description: Money the providers reported, or the price card computed, for settled API attempts.

reference_estimate.description: List-price estimate of the attempts with complete usage; not a charge.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every refused request: no tokens, prompts, source or stack traces.

EvaluationMode.description:
How a migration obligation is judged: the plan alone, or an observed
transition of a real environment, which needs evidence of that environment's state.

ExampleSnippet.description: Illustrative code the generator wrote; shown only under the `Example` label.

Exchange.description:
One question and its reply in one actor's private session; the tour and the result stay
as they are.

ExecutionOutcome.description: How the run reached FINALIZING; recorded inside the immutable result.

oneOf.description: A budget or size limit stopped the plan; skipped work is listed as gaps.
Retryable failures exhausted their retries; an honest partial result is kept.
Substantive analysis was impossible, for example the diff could not be read.

FeeShare.description:
A subscription fee for one calendar month (UTC); charged to the monthly pool once, not per
request or run.

finding.description: The finding as its latest run's result states it; `None` once that result was pruned.

FindingEvent.description: One lifecycle transition of a finding.

FindingPage.description: One page, newest first; pass `next_before` as `before` for the next one.

finding_id.description: The finding's id inside its run's result.

id.description: The id feedback is posted to.

severity.description: `None` for findings recorded before severities were kept.

Grant.description: A readable repository and the caller's role on it.

gaps.description: What the review could not establish; a fix does not settle it.

fix_criterion.description: What a fix must make true; the new head's review checks it again.

HandoffRequest.description: `POST /v1/runs/:id/handoff`: the run's own findings to export.

source_snapshot_id.description: Refused unless the run reviewed this snapshot.

LatestRun.description: The newest generation's run of a change.

unknown_obligations.description: Obligations the run could not assess; `None` before it finished.

Me.description: `GET /v1/me`: who the caller is and what it may do where.

actor.description: `github:<login>` for a person, the client name for an API client.

repositories.description: A person's roles as GitHub granted them at sign-in; every change is checked again live.

MicroUsd.description: Money as whole micro-USD; never a float.

Obligation.description: One concrete question with its rule, scope, acceptance criterion and assessment.

waivers.description: Scoped exceptions in force; they lower the risk decision and never rewrite `status`.

Overview.description: What every tour of the result must show, whatever its route.

PathGap.description: A path left out of reading or review, with the reason.

model_adapters.description: Model adapters used, e.g. `fake`; a fake adapter proves the harness, not model quality.

PublicationEntry.description: One delivery attempt of a summary, inline comment or check run.

QuestionRequest.description: `POST /v1/runs/:id/tours/:tour/questions`: a bounded follow-up on one step.

question.description: The question; for `FACT_REQUEST`, the caller's own statement of the missing fact.

waiver.description: Only with `RISK_DECISION`, which needs the maintainer role.

Recommendation.description: Computed by the reducer; never a model verdict or SCM approval.

oneOf.description: `COMPREHENSION`: generated prose; it can be wrong and is never technical evidence.

hypotheses.description: After the regular verifier; none of them is a finding of the review or published.

oneOf.description: `FACT_REQUEST`: the actor's own statement; it never rewrites an accepted requirement.
`RISK_DECISION`: a separate scoped waiver; the review's `UNKNOWN` and `VIOLATED` stay.

Repository.description: A repository the caller may read.

Requirement.description: A requirement a finding violates or depends on, with the review's status for it.

ReviewLanguage.description:
The language of every human-readable text a review writes (`review.language`): model
prose and the static text of published comments. Code, paths, ids and enum values stay as
they are.

checks.description:
Execution profiles to run with their parameters instead of every allowed one; the
server's profiles still decide whether and how each runs. Independent of `profile`,
which only sets the review depth.

publish.description: Off by default; on only where the connection publishes.

language.description: The language of the result's prose and of its publication.

ReviewUnit.description: Related changes reviewed together around one contract or behavior.

paths.description:
Where each file is reported: its new path, or old path when deleted. A renamed file's
old path is still part of its identity in the diff manifest.

risk_hints.description: Routing hints from the planner; not evidence of a defect.

RouteUsage.description: One model route of the run: how it bills and which caps are hard.

quota_attempts.description:
Subscription attempts settled with no reported money: they spent included quota, which
is not free. Remaining quota and its reset are not reported by any connected transport.

parent_run_id.description: The run this one continues, such as after late CI evidence.

unknown_obligations.description: Obligations the run could not assess; `None` before it finished.

ScopeManifest.description: Fixed before discovery; may only grow through a new revision.

SignIn.description: `GET /auth/github`: a connection people sign in through.

SubscriptionFee.description: A fixed subscription fee of the tenant; not attributed to a repository.

SuggestedChange.description:
The full new text of exactly the HEAD lines of `code`, which a comment can offer as a
one-click change.

Summary.description: `GET /v1/summary`: totals since `since` over the repositories the caller may read.

finding_events.description: Lifecycle transitions in the period by the state entered: found, resolved, dismissed.

queued_jobs.description: Current queue, not limited to the period.

reserved_micro_usd.description: Money still reserved by attempts in flight.

unknown_cost_attempts.description: Attempts whose charge is not known: never counted as zero cost.

Support.description: Kind of support; independent of severity.

TourArtifact.description: One tour of one result revision; never mutated, a regeneration is a new id.

generation_provenance.description: Route and attempts of the generation, e.g. `openrouter/deepseek, 2 attempts`.

TourId.description: One immutable tour of one result revision; regeneration makes a new one.

TourSession.description:
One actor's progress through one tour. It never changes the artifact, the
recommendation, obligations or any approval, and it is not published.

revealed.description: Steps whose answer was revealed, in order.

explanation.description: Free text; it can be wrong, and it never changes a status.

TourView.description: `GET /v1/runs/:id/tour` and the session calls: the tour as the caller's session sees it.

exchanges.description: The caller's own questions on this tour, oldest first; never another caller's.

session.description: The caller's own progress; never published and never an approval.

stale.description: A newer revision or generation of the change exists; the tour still shows what was reviewed.

tour.description: Answers not revealed in this session are blanked.

subscription_fees.description: Only for a caller that reads every repository and asked for no single one.

UsageDay.description: One UTC day of model usage.

reasoning_tokens.description: Already part of `output_tokens`; never added to it.

unknown_usage_attempts.description: Dispatched attempts whose tokens were not reported; the token sums leave them out.

Waiver.description: A rule exception in force for one obligation.

until.description: Completion condition when there is no fixed expiry.

WaiverRequest.description: `POST /v1/waivers`: a scoped risk decision; it never rewrites a status.

WaiverTerms.description: What a waiver accepts, for which paths and until when.
